"""RED oracle for ngv2.submission — render a huntr submission markdown from a
form dict + assemble the final submission package. Imports ngv2.contracts."""
from ngv2.contracts import Finding, PoC, LiveTestReport
from ngv2.submission import render_submission, assemble_package


FORM = {
    'repository': 'berriai/litellm',
    'package_manager': 'pypi',
    'affected_package': 'litellm',
    'version': '1.40.0',
    'vulnerability_type': 'Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)',
    'severity': 'high',
    'cvss_vector': 'AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N',
    'title': 'SSRF in proxy',
    'description': 'User URL reaches request()',
    'poc': 'requests.get(URL)',
    'impact': 'SSRF to internal services.',
    'occurrences': ['https://github.com/berriai/litellm/blob/abc/proxy.py#L410'],
}


def test_render_submission_is_markdown_with_sections():
    md = render_submission(FORM)
    assert isinstance(md, str)
    assert md.startswith('# huntr Submission')
    assert 'SSRF in proxy' in md
    assert '## Repository' in md and 'berriai/litellm' in md
    assert '## CVSS Vector' in md and FORM['cvss_vector'] in md
    assert '# Description' in md and 'User URL reaches request()' in md
    assert '# Proof of Concept' in md and 'requests.get(URL)' in md
    assert '# Impact' in md
    # occurrence permalink rendered
    assert 'proxy.py#L410' in md


def test_assemble_package_shape():
    finding = Finding(id='MDB-1', target='berriai/litellm', category='CWE-918',
                      severity='high', title='SSRF in proxy', description='d')
    poc = PoC(finding_id='MDB-1', language='python', code='c', entrypoint='exploit')
    live = LiveTestReport(poc_finding_id='MDB-1', verdict='confirmed', exit_code=0,
                          stdout='ok', stderr='', duration_ms=12)
    pkg = assemble_package(finding, poc, live)
    assert pkg['finding'] == finding.to_dict()
    assert pkg['poc'] == poc.to_dict()
    assert pkg['live_test'] == live.to_dict()
    assert pkg['verdict'] == 'confirmed'
    assert pkg['finding_id'] == 'MDB-1'


def test_assemble_package_is_json_serializable():
    import json
    finding = Finding(id='1', target='t', category='CWE-89', severity='low', title='x', description='d')
    poc = PoC(finding_id='1', language='python', code='c', entrypoint='e')
    live = LiveTestReport(poc_finding_id='1', verdict='refuted', exit_code=1,
                          stdout='', stderr='', duration_ms=0)
    pkg = assemble_package(finding, poc, live)
    json.dumps(pkg)  # must not raise

```
